title: CHAPEA Mission 2 Crew Reflects After 378 Days on Simulated Mars
summary: After 378 days without windows, the sounds of the outside world, or real-time calls with family and friends, four research volunteers stepped out of NASA’s Mars Dune Alpha habitat on Oct. 31, completing the agency’s second yearlong Mars surface simulation.
